description: Propose that a drafted pitch be sent. Drops the pitch into the human approval queue with a reason and confidence score; never sends directly. The approver sees your rationale alongside the message before they approve. Use this whenever a campaign agent has decided a pitch is ready to leave for a journalist.

agent_name.description: Name of the proposing agent (e.g. campaign-pitcher, liberty-radio)

agent_run_id.description: agent_sessions.id, if this proposal came from a managed-agent run

confidence.description: Your confidence the approver will agree with this pitch (0 to 1)

pitch_id.description: campaign_pitch_drafts.id of the draft you want to propose for send

reason.description: Plain-language reason this pitch is ready (e.g. why this contact, why this hook, why now). Surfaced verbatim to the approver.

scheduled_for.description: Optional ISO timestamp to schedule the send. Leave blank for immediate sending after approval.

name: tap_propose_send
